dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale-gray margins create distinct linear boundaries along the length of the folded flight feathers against the dark centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: The demarcation is defined by a textural transition from the uniform dark plumage of the crown to the start of the scalloped pattern on the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The specimen displays an extensive and uniform scalloped appearance across the entire dorsal surface caused by light feather fringes.
